rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the device used to hold a ship in place.

example.english: Before the tide goes out, the boatman has to drop the anchor.
example.traditional: 落潮之前，船家要先落錨。
example.jyutping: lok6 ciu4 zi1 cin4 syun4 gaa1 jiu3 sin1 lok6 naau4

rows.note: Use 落錨 as the all-purpose choice when a boat is anchored at a fixed point.

example.english: The boat drops anchor outside the pier.
example.jyutping: zek3 syun4 hai2 maa5 tau4 ngoi6 min6 lok6 maau4

rows.note: Use 固定 when securing a general object to a fixed point rather than specifically dropping a boat anchor.

example.english: We anchor the rack to the wall with screws.
example.traditional: 我哋用螺絲將個架固定喺牆上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 lo4 si1 zoeng1 go3 gaa3 gu3 ding6 hai2 coeng4 soeng6

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing that provides support, stability, or security, especially metaphorically.

example.english: Mom has always been the anchor of the whole family.
example.traditional: 阿媽一直係成個家庭嘅支柱。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 jat1 zik6 hai6 sing4 go3 gaa1 ting4 ge3 zi1 cyu5

rows.note: Use 支撐 when a person or relationship gives someone emotional support and stability during distress.

example.english: When times are hard, my friends anchor me.
example.traditional: 困難嗰陣，朋友一直支撐住我。
example.jyutping: kwan3 naan4 go2 zan6 pang4 jau5 jat1 zik6 zi1 caang1 zyu6 ngo5
